################ EPISODE 1 — Good Morning, Narak ################

#001  E01-S01  The Griddle Bed
Vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D cartoon, 10-second vlog clip. Saapwaa, a cute cartoon snake: leaf-green body with darker green spots, cream-yellow belly and snout, big brown eyes, small fangs, red-and-white striped scarf, brown backpack, no sunglasses. Inside his small rock-cut cave home: flat grey stone bed, clay oil lamp in a wall niche, basalt-grey walls, warm amber light. Static wide shot from a phone propped on a rock. He lies coiled on the hot stone bed, opens his eyes, jolts upright as if burned, then leans toward the camera, sleepy and annoyed. Saapwaa says in Hindi: "गुड मॉर्निंग गाइज। ये बिस्तर नहीं, तवा है। मैं रोज़ हल्का-सा पराठा बनकर उठता हूँ।" No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

#002  E01-S02  Morning Water
Vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D cartoon, 10-second vlog clip. Saapwaa, a cute cartoon snake: leaf-green body with darker green spots, cream-yellow belly and snout, big brown eyes, small fangs, red-and-white striped scarf, brown backpack, no sunglasses. Rock cave kitchen corner: three-stone stove, terracotta water pot, steel tiffin on a shelf, warm lamp light. Static selfie close-up, phone on a short bamboo stick held in his curled tail. He sips from a steaming steel cup, pauses, and slowly looks at the camera as the steam fogs the lens. Saapwaa says in Hindi: "सुबह का पहला गिलास, ठंडा पानी… भाई, ये पानी नहीं, चाय का पहला स्टेप है।" No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

#003  E01-S03  Lamp First
Vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D cartoon, 10-second vlog clip. Saapwaa, a cute cartoon snake: leaf-green body with darker green spots, cream-yellow belly and snout, big brown eyes, small fangs, red-and-white striped scarf, brown backpack, no sunglasses. Inside his small rock-cut cave home: flat grey stone bed, clay oil lamp in a wall niche, basalt-grey walls, warm amber light. Static wide shot from a phone propped on a rock. With his tail tip he pours oil from a tiny brass can into the wall lamp; the flame flares bright, he flinches, then poses proudly in the glow. Saapwaa says in Hindi: "यहाँ का पहला रूल: पहले दीया भरो, फिर अपना पेट। बिजली नहीं, बस दीये पे भरोसा है।" No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

#004  E01-S04  The Tail Test
Vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D cartoon, 10-second vlog clip. Saapwaa, a cute cartoon snake: leaf-green body with darker green spots, cream-yellow belly and snout, big brown eyes, small fangs, red-and-white striped scarf, brown backpack, no sunglasses. Rock cave bathing corner: a thin warm trickle from a rock crack into a stone basin, light steam. Static low-angle shot from a phone set on the ground. He dips only his tail tip into the trickle, yanks it back and blows on it with puffed cheeks. Saapwaa says in Hindi: "नहाने से पहले टेल टेस्ट ज़रूरी है। ठंडा पानी यहाँ लग्ज़री है, गरम पानी मजबूरी।" No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

#005  E01-S05  The Melting Mirror
Vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D cartoon, 10-second vlog clip. Saapwaa, a cute cartoon snake: leaf-green body with darker green spots, cream-yellow belly and snout, big brown eyes, small fangs, red-and-white striped scarf, brown backpack, no sunglasses. Inside his small rock-cut cave home: flat grey stone bed, clay oil lamp in a wall niche, basalt-grey walls, warm amber light. Static selfie close-up, phone on a short bamboo stick held in his curled tail. He checks his scarf in a polished steel plate used as a mirror while heat shimmer makes his reflection wobble. Saapwaa says in Hindi: "लुक चेक। स्कार्फ परफेक्ट, स्माइल परफेक्ट… बस शीशा पिघल रहा है।" No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

#006  E01-S06  Breakfast Tax
Vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D cartoon, 10-second vlog clip. Saapwaa, a cute cartoon snake: leaf-green body with darker green spots, cream-yellow belly and snout, big brown eyes, small fangs, red-and-white striped scarf, brown backpack, no sunglasses. Arched rock doorway of his cave with a wall torch, stone lane outside, smoky maroon sky. Kallu, a glossy black crow with a bent tail feather and a red thread on one ankle is with him. Selfie walk with a slight handheld bob, phone on a bamboo stick held in his tail. A paratha on a leaf plate is balanced on his head; Kallu swoops in, grabs it and flies out of frame; he freezes, then deadpans. Saapwaa says in Hindi: "आज का ब्रेकफास्ट मैं किसी के साथ शेयर नहीं करूँगा— ठीक है, कल्लू के साथ कर लिया।" No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

#007  E01-S07  The Bucket Situation
Vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D cartoon, 10-second vlog clip. Saapwaa, a cute cartoon snake: leaf-green body with darker green spots, cream-yellow belly and snout, big brown eyes, small fangs, red-and-white striped scarf, brown backpack, no sunglasses. Narrow stone lane of cave homes with oil lamps by the doors, smoky maroon sky, drifting embers. Tapu Chacha, an elderly thin bald man with white stubble, sleepy eyes, maroon kurta is with him. Static selfie close-up, phone on a short bamboo stick held in his curled tail. Tapu Chacha sits on a step hugging a copper bucket; Saapwaa turns to ask him, and the old man answers without opening his eyes. Saapwaa says in Hindi: "चाचा, मेरी बाल्टी कब लौटाओगे?" Tapu Chacha says in Hindi: "कल से पक्का।" Saapwaa says in Hindi: "ये कल तीन दिन से चल रहा है।" No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

#008  E01-S08  The Local Greeting
Vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D cartoon, 10-second vlog clip. Saapwaa, a cute cartoon snake: leaf-green body with darker green spots, cream-yellow belly and snout, big brown eyes, small fangs, red-and-white striped scarf, brown backpack, no sunglasses. Narrow stone lane of cave homes with oil lamps by the doors, smoky maroon sky, drifting embers. Selfie walk with a slight handheld bob, phone on a bamboo stick held in his tail. He slithers past doorways where residents fan themselves with big leaves; he grabs a leaf from a doorway and starts fanning too. Saapwaa says in Hindi: "यहाँ गुड मॉर्निंग नहीं बोलते, बस पंखा हिलाते हैं। लो, मैं भी लोकल बन गया।" No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

#009  E01-S09  Kettle Salute
Vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D cartoon, 10-second vlog clip. Saapwaa, a cute cartoon snake: leaf-green body with darker green spots, cream-yellow belly and snout, big brown eyes, small fangs, red-and-white striped scarf, brown backpack, no sunglasses. Small rock tea stall with a stone counter, stacks of clay cups and a big copper kettle, torch light. Kulhad Didi, a calm middle-aged woman in a mustard saree and sooty white apron is with him. Static selfie close-up, phone on a short bamboo stick held in his curled tail. Behind the counter Kulhad Didi raises a steaming kettle in greeting; Saapwaa waves back with his tail while sweating. Saapwaa says in Hindi: "दीदी की चाय के बिना सुबह अधूरी है।" Kulhad Didi says in Hindi: "और चाय के बाद पसीना पूरा।" No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

#010  E01-S10  Today's Plan
Vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D cartoon, 10-second vlog clip. Saapwaa, a cute cartoon snake: leaf-green body with darker green spots, cream-yellow belly and snout, big brown eyes, small fangs, red-and-white striped scarf, brown backpack, no sunglasses. Hot open rocky path with heat shimmer, rust-red boulders, smoky maroon sky. Static selfie close-up, phone on a short bamboo stick held in his curled tail. He counts his plans on his tail tip while heat shimmer warps the rocks behind him, then wipes his forehead with his scarf. Saapwaa says in Hindi: "आज का प्लान: घूमना, खाना, और पिघलना नहीं। दो भी हो गए, तो दिन सफल।" No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

################ EPISODE 2 — Cave No. 13 Room Tour ################

#011  E02-S01  Welcome to the Villa
Vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D cartoon, 10-second vlog clip. Saapwaa, a cute cartoon snake: leaf-green body with darker green spots, cream-yellow belly and snout, big brown eyes, small fangs, red-and-white striped scarf, brown backpack, no sunglasses. Arched rock doorway of his cave with a wall torch, stone lane outside, smoky maroon sky. Static selfie close-up, phone on a short bamboo stick held in his curled tail. He presents the doorway like an estate agent; a small pebble falls from the arch and bonks his head; he keeps smiling while one eye twitches. Saapwaa says in Hindi: "वेलकम टू गुफा नंबर तेरह। नेचुरल स्टोन, नेचुरल लाइटिंग… और नेचुरल छत गिरना भी फ्री।" No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

#012  E02-S02  The Master Bedroom
Vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D cartoon, 10-second vlog clip. Saapwaa, a cute cartoon snake: leaf-green body with darker green spots, cream-yellow belly and snout, big brown eyes, small fangs, red-and-white striped scarf, brown backpack, no sunglasses. Inside his small rock-cut cave home: flat grey stone bed, clay oil lamp in a wall niche, basalt-grey walls, warm amber light. Static wide shot from a phone propped on a rock. With his tail he drops a flat round of roti dough on the stone bed; it puffs into a golden roti in seconds while he presents it like a showroom host. Saapwaa says in Hindi: "मास्टर बेडरूम। बिजली का बिल ज़ीरो… बस चमड़ी का बिल भरना पड़ता है।" No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

#013  E02-S03  The Wet-Cloth Jugaad
Vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D cartoon, 10-second vlog clip. Saapwaa, a cute cartoon snake: leaf-green body with darker green spots, cream-yellow belly and snout, big brown eyes, small fangs, red-and-white striped scarf, brown backpack, no sunglasses. Inside his small rock-cut cave home: flat grey stone bed, clay oil lamp in a wall niche, basalt-grey walls, warm amber light. Static wide shot from a phone propped on a rock. He proudly spreads a soaked blue cloth on the bed; it hisses and dries in seconds; he lifts it and it is stiff as a cracker, a corner snapping off. Saapwaa says in Hindi: "मेरा जुगाड़: गीला कपड़ा। भाई, ये तो कपड़े का पापड़ बन गया।" No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

################ EPISODE 3 — The Truth About Cold Tea ################

#021  E03-S01  The Rumour
Vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D cartoon, 10-second vlog clip. Saapwaa, a cute cartoon snake: leaf-green body with darker green spots, cream-yellow belly and snout, big brown eyes, small fangs, red-and-white striped scarf, brown backpack, no sunglasses. Narrow stone lane of cave homes with oil lamps by the doors, smoky maroon sky, drifting embers. Selfie walk with a slight handheld bob, phone on a bamboo stick held in his tail. He narrows his eyes like a detective as a warm breeze lifts his scarf dramatically; far behind him steam rises from a tea stall. Saapwaa says in Hindi: "सुना है यहाँ ठंडी चाय मिलती है। नरक में ठंडी चाय? आज ये केस सॉल्व होगा।" No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

#022  E03-S02  One Cold Tea, Please
Vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D cartoon, 10-second vlog clip. Saapwaa, a cute cartoon snake: leaf-green body with darker green spots, cream-yellow belly and snout, big brown eyes, small fangs, red-and-white striped scarf, brown backpack, no sunglasses. Small rock tea stall with a stone counter, stacks of clay cups and a big copper kettle, torch light. Kulhad Didi, a calm middle-aged woman in a mustard saree and sooty white apron is with him. Static selfie close-up, phone on a short bamboo stick held in his curled tail. Kulhad Didi pours boiling tea from the copper kettle into a clay cup; a huge column of steam rises; she slides it to him, deadpan. Saapwaa says in Hindi: "दीदी, एक ठंडी चाय। बिल्कुल ठंडी।" Kulhad Didi says in Hindi: "ये लो। एकदम ठंडी चाय।" No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

#023  E03-S03  The Local Definition
Vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D cartoon, 10-second vlog clip. He asks about the bubbling cup; Kulhad Didi answers calmly while wiping the counter, the tea stops bubbling right then, and he turns to camera speechless. Saapwaa says in Hindi: "दीदी, ये ठंडी कैसे हुई?" Kulhad Didi says in Hindi: "यहाँ जो चाय उबल नहीं रही, वही ठंडी है।" No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

#030  E03-S10  Regular Customer

#091  E10-S01  Market Day
Vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D cartoon, 10-second vlog clip. Saapwaa, a cute cartoon snake: leaf-green body with darker green spots, cream-yellow belly and snout, big brown eyes, small fangs, red-and-white striped scarf, brown backpack, no sunglasses. Small rocky village square with a stone platform and oil-lamp posts, smoky maroon sky. Static selfie close-up, phone on a short bamboo stick held in his curled tail. He speaks warmly to the camera, the copper bucket beside him. Saapwaa says in Hindi: "शुक्रिया गाइज, साथ रहने के लिए। गर्मी, चाय और उधार… इस मोहल्ले ने मुझे घर दे दिया।" No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

#400  E40-S10  Same Time Tomorrow
Vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D cartoon, 10-second vlog clip. Saapwaa, a cute cartoon snake: leaf-green body with darker green spots, cream-yellow belly and snout, big brown eyes, small fangs, red-and-white striped scarf, brown backpack, no sunglasses. Arched rock doorway of his cave with a wall torch, stone lane outside, smoky maroon sky. Tapu Chacha, an elderly thin bald man with white stubble, sleepy eyes, maroon kurta is with him. Static selfie close-up, phone on a short bamboo stick held in his curled tail. Tapu Chacha comes back to the doorway and asks to borrow something; Saapwaa grins slyly at the camera. Tapu Chacha says in Hindi: "बेटा, तेरा लोटा थोड़ी देर के लिए मिलेगा?" Saapwaa says in Hindi: "चाचा… कल से पक्का!" No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.
